description: Source code implementing 2D unfolding operations for CPU in PyTorch, including functions for copying and accumulating unfolded data with support for channels-last memory format.

methods.name: cadd
methods.description: Performs element-wise addition of two vectors and stores the result in the destination pointer.

methods.name: unfolded2d_acc
methods.description: Accumulates unfolded 2D data into input tensor, supporting parallel execution and padding.

methods.name: unfolded2d_acc_channels_last
methods.description: Specialized accumulation for channels-last memory format.

methods.name: unfolded2d_acc_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches to appropriate accumulation function based on memory format and data type.

methods.name: unfolded2d_copy
methods.description: Copies data from input tensor to unfolded format, supporting padding and different memory formats.

methods.name: unfolded2d_copy_channels_last
methods.description: Specialized copy for channels-last memory format.

methods.name: unfolded2d_copy_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches to appropriate copy function based on memory format and data type.
